_meta.status: documented-behavior fixture; replaces live wire until budget approved
_meta.reference_model: gpt-4o (representative; cached-input discount varies 50-90% by model)
notes: AUTOMATIC caching for prompts >= 1024 tokens; hits in 128-token increments past 1024.
No write premium (writes billed at base input rate).
Cached-input discount ~50% on gpt-4o; some newer models document up to 75-90% - fixture uses 50%.
Retention is best-effort: docs say caches evict after 5-10 min of inactivity, up to ~1 h off-peak; fixture models 300 s.
Eviction clock is 'since last use', modeled as refresh_on_hit=true.

ttl_value: docs give a 5-10 min best-effort RANGE, not a contract value; the 300 s here is the low end.
